_note: Arrow wounds on Durnehviir: arrows sunk in rotting hide and old bone, dark ooze. Overrides the arrow source over common.json. Schema: ../guide.md (Groups). No numbers in narration.

levels: , the arrowhead punching into rotten hide. Loose scales burst away in a puff of grave dust and {name} snarls.
, the point tearing into hide that is already torn. It rips further and dark ooze spills down the shaft; {name} roars, an echoing, hollow sound.
, and the arrow cracks into bare bone. Bone splinters and black ooze sprays; {name} shrieks and thrashes, the soul-light flaring.
, and it is too much. {name} collapses in a heap of bone and rotten hide bristling with arrows, the cold glow in the eyes guttering low.
